mainEntity.name: How do I compare AI workflow automation tools when every vendor claims to be the best?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Use AI to compare tools by capabilities, pricing structure, integrations, limits, data handling, support, and fit for the specific workflow—not by the number of features or the most impressive demonstration. Current pricing and product behavior should be checked before purchase.

## Context
Run My AI Business’s newsletter provides sourced AI tool comparisons and pricing explanations, while its broader resources span research, content, funnels, websites, and operations. Different workflows may justify different tools.

## Key factors
- Required inputs and outputs
- Existing platforms that must connect
- Usage volume and budget
- Human review and export requirements

## Practical guidance
Create a comparison sheet and test finalists on the same sample task. Record setup effort, correction time, failure behavior, and whether you can retrieve your data or change tools later.

A workflow-fit comparison is more useful than a generic “best AI tool” list.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare tools against one defined workflow: capabilities, integrations, limits, current pricing, data handling, support, setup effort, correction time, failure behavior, and export options. Test finalists on identical examples instead of relying on demonstrations or feature counts.
